schema.description: [TG-FCT-6b] `credentials` group: the non-ECS Verifiable Trust Credentials presented by the DID (`Vtc` records reachable via `Did —REFERENCES_VP→ LVP —CONTAINS_VTC→ Vtc`). ECS credentials (ServiceCredential / OrganizationCredential / PersonaCredential) MUST NOT appear here — they are projected by the `service` and `operator` groups. A presented VTC is by definition held by the DID (no role field). `entries` MAY be truncated to an implementation-defined maximum; `total` always reflects the untruncated population.

total.description: Count of distinct `Vtc` records presented by the DID.

id.description: The VTC's credential id (`Vtc.id`) — the B1 / B2 traversal anchor.

schemaTitle.description: `title` of the loaded `CredentialSchema.body`; `null` when the body declares no title.

attributes.description: The credential's `credentialSubject` claims verbatim, minus the subject `id` (the hit's own DID); `null` when the implementation has not fetched the VP body per [TG-DEREF-3] (the fetch is RECOMMENDED).
